task: Detect and resolve CI run on superseded commit while branch HEAD has advanced

perceive.observation: CI workflow run reported failure on commit ffb9a74b3437 while the PR branch HEAD was already at 3a94f7a043f2 — a later commit pushed by automated session tooling.
signals: run.head_sha != pull_request.head.sha in workflow_run API response
Rescue comment posted for a commit that is no longer the branch tip
pre-commit end-of-file-fixer failed on .github/workflows/resilient_validation.yml (trailing blank line)
Root cause commit (S235-B) removed last job from resilient_validation.yml but left trailing blank line
pattern_triggers: automated commits (chore(auth), chore(d00)) pushed AFTER agent code commit
CI pipeline triggered on the code commit before automation commits advanced HEAD
two diverged SHA references in same CI event: run.head_sha vs PR head_sha

decide.rationale: The failure is on a superseded commit. The fix (trailing newline) must still be applied because the pre-commit hook WILL re-run on the new HEAD if the file remains unchanged.
decide.auto_fix_pattern: end-of-file-fixer — strip trailing blank lines from YAML workflow files

act.fix_applied: Removed trailing blank line from .github/workflows/resilient_validation.yml (line 372 → EOF)
act.verification: tail -3 | cat -A shows single trailing $\n; wc -l reduced from 372 to 371
act.commit_message: fix(S236): remove trailing blank line from resilient_validation.yml (end-of-file-fixer)

aftermath.lesson: When a CI run references a stale commit (run.head_sha != PR head_sha), the failure is still actionable: the same file defect will re-trigger on the current HEAD unless fixed.
aftermath.detection_heuristic: Compare run.head_sha with PR head.sha in rescue-comment context; if they differ, annotate the rescue comment with '⚠️ This run was on a superseded commit (HEAD has since advanced)' and still apply the fix.

auto_fix_candidate.trigger: end-of-file-fixer hook fails on a .github/workflows/*.yml file
auto_fix_candidate.root_cause: Job removal (e.g., S235-B duplicate rescue-comment removal) left a trailing blank line
auto_fix_candidate.fix: Strip trailing blank lines, ensure exactly one \n at EOF

stale_commit_run_pattern.description: CI rescue comment or workflow run references a commit SHA that is no longer the PR branch HEAD
detection: Rescue CI comment SHA is older than git log HEAD
response_protocol: 1. Acknowledge the run is on a superseded commit in any reply
2. Still investigate and fix the underlying failure — it will recur on HEAD
3. Re-run `sync_tracked_files.py --fix` after fix to confirm no drift
4. Annotate rescue comment reply with commit hash that actually fixes the issue
stale_commit_run_pattern.false_positive_risk: LOW — stale run failures almost always indicate a real defect in a shared file

problems_solved.root_cause: S235-B removed the workflow-level rescue-comment job (lines ~369-371) but the surrounding blank line became the new EOF trailing blank, violating end-of-file-fixer

key_changes: Stripped trailing blank line; file now ends with single \n
